posts.body: I had my 12 week scan last week and my hubby asked if you could tell what it was. The sonographer had a look and said 65% boy.  This surprised me as I didn't think you could find out this early so I came home and did some research on the internet and found the "nub theory". Without mentioning this to hubby I asked him if he thought a certain bit was vertical or horizontal to which I got a resounding horizontal.  This contradicts what we were told and looking closely at my scan picture I can see 3 lines - although one is slightly longer than the other - which also seems to indicate girl altho' am not 100% sure if I am looking in the right place.  My "gut" feeling is girl and my "gut" was right with my little boy.  I just think 65% isn't a big enough percentage and I don't want to get excited about another little boy in case it's wrong.   Just wondered if anyone else had been given the wrong gender so early on?  😕

I'm surprised she told you if she was only 65% sure! They normally want to be pretty certain before indicating and as it was just 12 weeks probably should have waited to give you a clearer answer at your later scan. I was told with my middle child at the 12 week scan that we were having a boy and this was right, but with my first child I had to have several scans and at 15 weeks I was told it was a boy only to go back at 20 weeks and have someone else tell me that was wrong and I was having a girl and yes I had already been out and bought clothes!! I would say don't rely totally on it at this point, wait until your next scan.
I  think it possible to know, I'm sure I know of someone who found out at their 12 week. I would just hang on until your 20 week when they can be more certain x
Up here the forth valley nhs (central scotland) wont tell you what your having wither or no you ask. I believe its because they've got it wrong so many times.

Yeah i personally would just pretend you haven't heard and start again at your 20wk scan. They weren't sure so there is no point taking it as red that it is a boy! Hopefully things will be clearer at the next scan for you Xx
i he always been told u cant tell untill at least 17 weeks lol but they wont tell u before 20 here x
I wouldn't rely too heavily on that assessment at such an early stage.
I believe the earliest time possible to determine the gender is 16 weeks.

Hi all
I live in Yorkshire and dont want to know when I go for my scan in 2 weeks.  I just want to know that everything is ok.  Will they automatically tell us or ask if we want to know the sex of the baby?  Personally, I don't want to know so I don't want them to blurt it out!   I like surprises, and my husband is happy to go along with that.  I have no idea what to expect this time around, so much has changed.  Thanks all.
hi - u'll only be told ur babies gender if u ask and if the mother wants to know. they will not tell you otherwise and some areas refuse to give genders for many reasons x
